purpose: Safely apply recovered original-marketplace evidence to an existing realized sale without changing the sale sample.
original_locator_rule: At least one qualifying original marketplace locator is required: a direct marketplace URL whose host matches the stored marketplace, or a stable original marketplace sale identifier.
identity_match_rules: task_id must resolve to the current verification queue
sale_index must resolve to the stored realized sale
sale date and sale price must exactly match the stored sample
serial_copy must match when the stored sale has one
mutations_on_success: promote calculated_market_value status only when evidence state warrants it
fail_closed_rules: Dry-run is the default CLI behavior.
Any identity, date, price, marketplace, serial or locator mismatch rejects the evidence.
Rejected evidence must leave the market record unchanged.
Verification must never change realized sale prices.
Contribution verification is derived from all supporting market-record sales, not from a contribution-level boolean.
